C1724.title: The 'Xingyuan' App and the Cai Xukun 100 Million Retweet Case
C1724.summary: In 2018, Cai Kunmiao, founder of the 'Xingyuan' App, intercepted Sina Weibo data packets and decompiled them, inserting forged interfaces into the app. This allowed users to retweet posts in bulk without logging in, enabling data fraud.
